definition: Metorik WW and Metorik USD are the historical Woo order authorities for their respective stores.
Matrixify Shopify orders are migrated Woo representations and are excluded from Shopify-native governed order and customer measures; they are not second sales.

definition: Historical Woo shipping geography uses direct Metorik export evidence only and has incomplete coverage; unresolved geography is not inferred.
Search Console canonical selection prefers Domain evidence and falls back to historical www evidence without summing the properties.

term: first observed customer and repeat customer
definition: First purchase means first observed qualifying purchase in available source history. Repeat means at least two qualifying observed orders for one source-qualified identified customer; unresolved guest orders are excluded.
